applicability: Applies to undergraduates who take or retake a cross-listed course (one course offered under several majors' numbers).

consequence.quote: ※ Cross-listing 교과목인 A, B 교과목 중 A 교과목을 이수한 후 재수강하고자 하는 경우, 기존에 이수한 교과목인 A 교과목을 신청해야만 재이수 가능
consequence.text: A retake counts only if registered under the originally completed course number.

eligibility_quotes: ※ 본인의 전공이 아닌 Cross-listing된 타 전공 교과목 수강 시 ‘일반선택’으로 학점인정 처리됨에 유의
○ (재수강) 학생이 Cross-listing 교과목을 재수강하고자 하는 경우, 기존에 이수하였던 교과목번호로 개설되는 강좌를 신청

english_match.note: Not checked against the English board.

steps: Check whether a course is cross-listed before course registration.
Register under your own major's course number to get major credit.
To retake, register under the course number you originally completed.
summary: Cross-listed courses outside your major count as general electives. To retake one, register under the course number you originally took.
title: Register cross-listed courses under the correct number

translations.※ Cross-listing 교과목인 A, B 교과목 중 A 교과목을 이: ※ If, between cross-listed courses A and B, a student completed course A and wishes to retake it, the retake is possible only by registering for course A, the course previously completed.
translations.※ 본인의 전공이 아닌 Cross-listing된 타 전공 교과목 수강: ※ Note that if you take a cross-listed course of another major that is not your own major, the credit is recognized as 'general elective'.
translations.○ (재수강) 학생이 Cross-listing 교과목을 재수강하고자 하는: ○ (Retake) If a student wishes to retake a cross-listed course, they must register for the class offered under the course number they previously completed.

who: Undergraduates taking or retaking cross-listed courses

original.text: Cross-listing 교과목 이수시 유의사항을 아래와 같이 안내하오니 확인해주시기 바랍니다.
※ 본인의 전공이 아닌 Cross-listing된 타 전공 교과목 수강 시 ‘일반선택’으로 학점인정 처리됨에 유의
○ (학점인정) 학생이 Cross-listing 교과목을 수강한 경우, 본인이 수강신청한 각 전공 교과목을 이수한 것으로 성적표기
○ (재수강) 학생이 Cross-listing 교과목을 재수강하고자 하는 경우, 기존에 이수하였던 교과목번호로 개설되는 강좌를 신청
※ Cross-listing 교과목인 A, B 교과목 중 A 교과목을 이수한 후 재수강하고자 하는 경우, 기존에 이수한 교과목인 A 교과목을 신청해야만 재이수 가능

english: Please check the following points about taking Cross-listing courses (courses offered jointly under more than one major's course number).
※ Please note: if you take a Cross-listed course under another major's course number, not your own major's, the credits will be counted as '일반선택' (General Elective).
○ (Credit recognition) When a student takes a Cross-listing course, the transcript will show the course under the major's course number that the student registered for.
○ (Retaking) If a student wants to retake a Cross-listing course, the student must register for the class offered under the same course number that the student completed before.
※ For example, if Course A and Course B are Cross-listing courses and you completed Course A, you can retake it only by registering for Course A, the course you completed before.
